Listbox

A scrollable list of options with single or multiple selection, driven by arrow keys and typeahead — the selection engine that Select and Combobox open in a popup and that stands alone as a visible picker.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Listbox } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

Apple
Banana
Cherry
Date
Elderberry
import { Listbox, type ListboxOption } from '@design-schema/react';

const FRUITS: ListboxOption[] = [
  { value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
  { value: 'banana', label: 'Banana' },
  { value: 'cherry', label: 'Cherry' },
  { value: 'date', label: 'Date' },
  { value: 'elderberry', label: 'Elderberry' },
];

<Listbox label="Fruit" options={FRUITS} />

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
label requiredstring—

Accessible name of the list. When a visible Text label exists, pass its id via `labelledBy` instead and this is ignored.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
labelledBystring—

Id of a visible element that labels the list.

web, lit
options requiredarray ({ value: string; label: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean } | { group: string; options: ListboxOption[] })[]—

Flat or grouped options. Export the item type as `ListboxOption`.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
multiplebooleanfalse

Allow any number of selections. The value becomes an array; each option shows a check indicator; selection toggles rather than moves. This is the same engine Combobox uses for multi-select.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
valuestring | string[]—

Controlled selection: a value, or with `multiple` the exported `ListboxValue` (`string | string[]`). Omit for uncontrolled.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
defaultValuestring | string[]—

Initial selection (or array).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
selectionFollowsFocusbooleantrue

Single-select only: arrow keys select as they move (the common picker feel). Set false when selection has side effects, so arrows only move and Space selects.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
requiredbooleanfalse

At least one option must be selected to submit when inside a Form.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
invalidbooleanfalse

Marks the list invalid (aria-invalid) with `copy.invalid`.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
errorstring—

Error message rendered below the list and linked by aria-describedby; implies invalid.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
embeddedbooleanfalse

The list lives inside a popup (Select, Combobox) that owns the border, surface and radius; the list draws none of its own.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
initialActiveValuestring—

The option that is active when the list first receives focus (Select opens with the selected option active). Defaults to the first selected, else the first enabled option.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
loadingbooleanfalse

Options are being fetched (async Combobox); the list shows `copy.loading` in place of the empty message and is aria-busy.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
disabledbooleanfalse

The whole list is inert but readable.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
namestring—

Field name for Form collection. Multiple values are collected as an array.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
emptyMessagestring—

Shown when `options` is empty (a filtered Combobox with no matches). Defaults to `copy.empty`.

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Height in rows before the list scrolls; `all` never scrolls.

Events

EventTypeDescriptionPlatforms
onChangeonChange / change

Fired when the selection changes, with the new value (array when `multiple`).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onActiveChangeonActiveChange / active-change

Fired as the focused (active) option changes, with its value — Combobox uses this to keep aria-activedescendant in sync; consumers rarely need it.

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Supply an accessible name. This component has no text of its own to fall back on, so without one a screen reader announces its role and nothing else.

Supply the error text when the value is invalid. The component links and announces it; it cannot write it.

Implicit ARIA role: listbox.

Anatomy

listgroupgroupLabeloptionoptionLabeloptionDescriptionoptionIconoptionCheckemptyState

What generation guarantees

Accessible name — Every instance carries a programmatic name. Where the component has no text of its own to use, the name is a prop the consumer supplies.

Selected state — Selection is exposed programmatically (`aria-selected` / `aria-checked`).

Arrow navigation — Arrow keys move between items; Home and End jump to the ends.

Keyboard operable — Everything the pointer can do here, the keyboard can do — see the keyboard section.

Visible focus — Keyboard focus is always drawn, from the theme’s focus tokens, and is never removed.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.

Target size — Interactive targets are at least 24×24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 Target Size, minimum).

Error identification — An invalid value is identified in text and linked to the control — never signalled by colour alone.

10 rows

Listbox keyboard support

KeyAction
ArrowDownMoves to the next enabled option (and selects it when selection follows focus).
ArrowUpMoves to the previous enabled option.
HomeFirst option.
EndLast option.
SpaceSelects the focused option; with `multiple`, toggles it.
EnterSelects the focused option (single) — inside a Select or Combobox, also closes the popup.
Shift+ArrowDown or Shift+ArrowUpMultiple: moves and adds the next/previous option to the selection. (multiple)
Control+aMultiple: selects all enabled options; again clears. (multiple)
a-zTypeahead to the next option whose label starts with the typed characters.
PageDown or PageUpMoves by the visible row count.
